title: tower space heater
text:
tower space heater. UPDATE BELOW......Out of the box, it's awesome. It's quiet and simple to use. Easy screw on base - which is weighted. I like that the fan is not noisy and the oscillating motion is also very quiet - important to me because I am sensitive to underlying noise. I needed this for an ofc/stuff room that is out in our shop/storage/garage. The thermometer is critical. So far, it's run and kept the room dry and comfortable - about 300 sq ft. It is mostly black plastic, metal grill (dots) in the front. It does run the fan a few minutes when it shuts down a few minutes to make sure it's not hot. It would be difficult to knock it over, but it does shut down if knocked over. Once the power has been disconnected ( power out or it's been knocked over) you will have to reset all settings. You can use the remote or on the face of the unit using pressure button/controls. The remote is small and flat - uses a coin battery which is included and installed - just remove the clear tab. There is a flat ledge in the back where the battery can rest - just under the handle grip - which makes it easy to find if you're not really using it a lot. In our case, we set it and leave it - resetting if we have a power out. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this review was helpful to you.
UPDATE: 11/14/2019.... Well. After just one day use, it doesn't properly function. No matter what temp you set it on, it still runs... 24/7... heating even when it's 15 or 20 degrees hotter in the room than the temp setting! And that's because even tho the temp was set at 62 it was heating the room to 78 or 80! Should have shut off when the temp set was reached. Super disappointed. It was too expensive not to properly function.
